units.source_text: 惊动山民恐多麻烦，便命令随从者不可扬声。

en.t: Fearing it would cause much trouble if they disturbed the mountain villagers, he ordered his attendants not to raise their voices.

units.source_text: 穿过许多柴篱，渡过流水潺潺的浅涧，踏湿了的马足还是小心翼翼地悄悄前进。

en.t: They passed through many brushwood fences, crossed shallow streams murmuring with flowing water, and the horses, their feet wet, still advanced quietly and with great care.

units.source_text: 然而薰君身上的香气无法隐藏，随风四散飘流。

en.t: Yet the fragrance on Lord Kaoru could not be hidden, and it drifted everywhere on the wind.

units.source_text: 山家睡醒了的人都很惊诧：不闻有谁经过，何来这股异香？

en.t: Those who had awakened in the mountain houses were all astonished: they had heard no one pass by, so where had this strange fragrance come from?
